text:
Nora - CSM: Heads-up: NimbusQ onboarding. Their UX team reports elevated tail latency and API cost spikes during peak. Majority of calls are short chats (~16 tokens) but there are occasional doc-generation bursts (seq ~300). Renewal in 4 weeks, they'd like a low-risk pilot.

Ethan - ML Eng: Sounds like a classic split-by-length + compact quant opportunity. Short interactive -> compact-int8 or int4; long batches -> standard fp16 or dedicated. We'll need to validate for their invoice-parsing templates.

Priya - SuccessOps: Proposed pilot: 4% short-path to compact-int8, sample 600 canonical prompts for quality checks, enable prefix cache for repeated confirmations. Guard rails and rollback steps included.

Sam - SRE: Safety: only run pilot 09:00-17:00 customer local Mon-Fri. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.6% or p95 increases >12% over baseline. Alert their SRE channel on any deviation.

Mila - PM: Define success for renewal: cost reduction >=15% OR p95 improvement >=12% with <=0.8% quality regression on key templates (measured by embedding-similarity + numeric equality). If met, include as renewal optimization in the proposal.

Ethan - ML Eng: I'll run a 600-sample regression and post results. Suggested dry-run routing config to push to Console:

```
route_policy:
  - name: nimbusq-short-canary
    match: "request.tokens <= 48 && rand() < 0.04"
    target_model: gpt-compact-int8-v1
    fallback: gpt-compact-fp16-v1
    latency_slo_ms: 450
    metrics: [p95, error_rate, embedding_similarity, numeric_match]
  - name: nimbusq-long-path
    match: "request.tokens > 48"
    target_model: gpt-standard-fp16-v2
slo_guards:
  error_rate_threshold_pct: 0.6
  p95_increase_pct_threshold: 12
monitoring:
  sample_size: 600
  lookback_minutes: 60
cache:
  prefix_cache: true
  ttl_seconds: 240
```

Ethan - ML Eng: I'll also run a quick human spot-check on 50 critical prompts to catch any edge-case regressions. Expect overall latency drop for short calls and ~18% cost reduction estimate for short-path if behavior matches past pilots.

Priya - SuccessOps: I'll prepare the one-pager + rollback playbook for NimbusQ and schedule a 30-minute ops walkthrough. Suggest initial canary Wed 09:00 local.

routing-bot: created canary workspace '/canaries/4298765432-nimbusq-preview' (dry-run). Alerts: '/alerts/4298765432'. Runbook attached: '/runbooks/nimbusq-int8-rollback'.

Sam - SRE: If Ethan's regression looks clean, we can add a dynamic ramp: increase to 15% during off-peak (00:00-06:00) for 8 hours, with checks every 10m (error_rate < 0.4% and p95 < 500ms).

Nora - CSM: I'll loop in NimbusQ and get opt-in for Wed. Action items: Ethan -> 600-sample regression + spot-check; Priya -> one-pager + walkthrough; Sam -> alerts + ramp policy; Mila -> renewal wording draft. Will update thread when customer confirms. :white_check_mark:
